question: Who among the following authored the book ‘Sarvajanik Satyadharma’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jyotiba Phule**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Jyotiba Phule, a prominent social reformer and thinker, authored the book **'Sarvajanik Satyadharma'**.
 
• The book emphasizes equality and justice and was written to challenge the caste system and social injustices prevailing during the 19th century.
 
• Phule used his writings, including 'Sarvajanik Satyadharma,' to advocate for the upliftment of oppressed communities, especially the Dalits and women.
 
• This book reflects his broader philosophy of Satyashodhak Samaj (Society of Truth Seekers), which he founded in 1873 to promote social equality.
 
• Jyotiba Phule’s contributions extended to education reform, where he worked tirelessly to promote the education of women and lower-caste individuals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jyotiba Phule:** Born in 1827 in Maharashtra, he was a pioneer of social reform movements in India and is often referred to as the "Father of Indian Social Revolution."
 
• **Satyashodhak Samaj:** An organization founded by Phule to fight against Brahmanical supremacy and to advocate for the rights of marginalized communities.
 
• **Educational Reforms:** Phule, along with his wife Savitribai Phule, opened the first school for girls in India in 1848, marking a major step towards gender equality in education.
 
• **Other Works:** Jyotiba Phule also authored 'Gulamgiri' (Slavery), which criticized caste-based discrimination and oppression.
 
• **Legacy:** Jyotiba Phule's work laid the foundation for the social justice movements that followed, inspiring leaders like B.R. Ambedkar in their fight for equality and rights for the oppressed.
